prompt: Use dealectric.com to find a power station and solar panel combo for an RV. Dealectric's page for it: https://dealectric.com/lab/V0/allpowers-r4000-3456wh
text:
Dealectric doesn't sell an R4000 bundle with panels. You can pair the R4000 with the ALLPOWERS SP037 panel yourself, or pick one of its pre-made kits that uses a smaller power station.

**Option 1: R4000 plus SP037 panels (my pick for an RV)**
- **[ALLPOWERS R4000 (3,456 Wh)](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-r4000-3456wh)**
  - It's LiFePO4 with 3,600 W continuous output at 120 V (6,000 W peak) and an RV outlet.
  - The price is $1,499, or $1,319.12 with code EXTRA12. That code needs an order over $1,200 and expires 11/15/2026.
  - It takes up to 2,000 W of solar across 3 XT60 inputs. Each input handles 650 W at 12–60 V.
  - It weighs 45 kg (about 99 lb) and has a 5-year warranty.
- **[ALLPOWERS SP037 400 W foldable panel](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel)**
  - The price is $299, or $269.10 with code ALLPOWERS26.
  - Its open-circuit voltage is about 45 V, which is inside the R4000's 12–60 V input range.
  - Dealectric doesn't explicitly confirm the SP037 works with the R4000, so confirm with ALLPOWERS before buying.
  - Checkout usually accepts one code per order. You probably can't use EXTRA12 on the station and ALLPOWERS26 on the panel in the same order, so check at checkout.

Two SP037 panels would give you 800 W for about $540 with the code. The R4000 and two panels would come to roughly $1,860. Three panels would use all three inputs, but 2,000 W of solar is only reachable with enough panels to fill them.

**Option 2: A pre-made kit, if you want something smaller and cheaper**
- [ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SP037 (1,451 Wh, 400 W)](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-s2000-pro-sp037-solar-kit): $963, or $866.70 with ALLPOWERS26.
- [ALLPOWERS P1800 + SP037 (1,024 Wh, 400 W)](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit): $731, or $657.90 with ALLPOWERS26.
- [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W panel (2,073.6 Wh)](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit): $1,199, or $1,139.05 with AFF5OFF.

**Things to know**
- The R4000 page says sale items can't be returned under ALLPOWERS' refund policy. Dealectric's page also gives a 30-day return window for unused items, with the buyer paying return shipping unless the item is defective.
- Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through its links, at no extra cost to you.
- Prices were checked in the last few days, and the store's checkout is the final word.

If you tell me how much you run in the RV (an AC, a fridge, or just electronics), I can help decide how much battery and how many panels you need.
